# Visio fixtures

These files are from the test data of libvisio
(https://git.libreoffice.org/libvisio, `src/test/data`) and are licensed under the
Mozilla Public License 2.0 (https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/), unlike the rest of this
repository.

- `dwg.vsd`, `dwg.vsdx`: the same drawing in the binary and the XML format, four
  shapes placed from masters.
- `Visio11FormatLine.vsd`: Visio 2003, connectors from a master and labels.
- `Visio11TextFieldsWithAngle.vsd`: Visio 2003, text with fields.
- `Visio6TextFieldsWithUnits.vsd`: Visio 2000, text with fields in various units.
